title: Lead Compute Platform Engineer
description:
WHO WE ARE 

Zeta Global (NYSE: ZETA) is the AI-Powered Marketing Cloud that leverages advanced artificial intelligence (AI) and trillions of consumer signals to make it easier for marketers to acquire, grow, and retain customers more efficiently. Through the Zeta Marketing Platform (ZMP), our vision is to make sophisticated marketing simple by unifying identity, intelligence, and omnichannel activation into a single platform – powered by one of the industry’s largest proprietary databases and AI. Our enterprise customers across multiple verticals are empowered to personalize experiences with consumers at an individual level across every channel, delivering better results for marketing programs. Zeta was founded in 2007 by David A. Steinberg and John Sculley and is headquartered in New York City with offices around the world. To learn more, go to www.zetaglobal.com.

The Role 

As a Senior Compute Platform Engineer on the Data Platform team, you will be part of the group responsible for building and running the data infrastructure that powers Zeta's platform, including Zeta’s lakehouse platform. The Data Platform team delivers reliable, cost-efficient data processing that scales with growth — so engineers and analysts can focus on business problems instead of wrestling with infrastructure. 

The Data Platform team empowers data scientists and data engineers through a Scala data warehouse framework designed for data modeling and the creation of type-safe and easily testable batch jobs. title: Enterprise Account Executive - Spanish -Speaking  - London, UK
description:
About Pallet

Pallet is building AI Agents to transform the physical economy — a $12 trillion global industry. We’ve raised $50M from top investors, including General Catalyst, Bessemer Venture Partners, and Bain Capital Ventures. In under two years, we’ve achieved 700% revenue growth and are just getting started.

Our mission is to increase the efficiency of the global supply chain by automating the manual workflows that slow supply chain teams down — from scheduling and appointment setting to data entry and load management. Our flagship platform provides end-to-end visibility, control, and optimization, while our newest product, CoPallet, introduces AI Agents that can understand and execute requests in real time and integrate directly with customer systems.

As companies across the physical economy look to generative AI to drive efficiency, many are turning to Pallet to lead the way. With deep supply chain expertise and cutting-edge AI capabilities, we’re positioned to build the next $10B company powering the physical economy.

Join us and work alongside leaders from Google, DoorDash, YC, and more to shape the future of supply chain technology.

London, United Kingdom or Zurich, Switzerland (Remote to start, transitioning to 5 days/week in-office once our local office opens)

You could be an Enterprise Account Executive anywhere. Why us?

  • Join a well-funded, high-growth startup on a clear path to $100M ARR.
  • Sell a category-defining AI Agents platform with massive surface area across logistics.
  • Build Pallet’s presence across Europe as one of the first commercial hires on the ground.

title: Product Designer (m/f/d)- Physical Products & AI - home decor brand - 100% remote - part-/fulltime
description:
For my client, an established direct-to-consumer home decor brand, I’m looking for a talented Product Designer to join the team on a long-term basis.
 The company creates distinctive wooden home decor for customers primarily in the US, with a strong focus on wall art alongside selected freestanding pieces.
 We’re looking for someone who combines a strong design eye with commercial thinking and hands-on AI skills — someone who can turn ideas and market insights into products customers genuinely want to buy.
 Tasks
 Your main responsibility will be to develop new, sellable physical products from idea to launch .
 You’ll identify promising product opportunities through a mix of market and competitor research, emerging trends, existing bestsellers and your own creative ideas.
 From there, you’ll take concepts through the full development process:
 Create and visualize new product concepts using AI image-generation tools
 Refine ideas into commercially viable product directions
 Collaborate with CAD designers to translate concepts into manufacturable designs
 Work with suppliers and factories throughout sampling and development
 Coordinate with the content and advertising teams to prepare products for launch
 Manage several product concepts and development projects in parallel
 Requirements
 Hands-on experience with AI image generation , using tools such as Nano Banana, Adobe Firefly, Flux or similar
 Experience designing physical products — not solely graphic, digital or UX/UI design
 A strong eye for aesthetics, form and commercial product design , demonstrated through a portfolio
 Highly organized, reliable and comfortable managing multiple projects simultaneously
 Fluent English
 Strong Plus
 Experience in home decor, furniture, interiors or lifestyle products
 A background working with wood, handcrafted products or similar materials
 A strong understanding of US home decor trends and customer preferences
